field_meaning.hi: गलती से बहुत दूर होने वाला नुकसान।

review_objections: Alibaba: The Hindi meaning 'गलती से बहुत दूर होने वाला नुकसान' (damage occurring far from the mistake) is incorrect. 'Remoteness of damage' is a legal principle in torts determining whether the damage is too remote (indirect) to be recoverable, not about physical distance.
